name: @smartv/desktop
description: Smart TV desktop app (Electron) for Windows
author: SmartTV

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node scripts/publish-preload.mjs && vite build --config vite.renderer.ts
